task: Classify histologic subtype in colorectal adenocarcinoma. Classes: conventional adenocarcinoma vs. mucinous adenocarcinoma. The main H&E distinction is the amount of extracellular mucin and whether tumor cells float within mucin pools rather than forming predominantly conventional glands.

classes.0: Conventional adenocarcinoma with predominantly gland-forming malignant epithelium and little extracellular mucin.
classes.1: Mucinous adenocarcinoma with abundant extracellular mucin pools containing floating clusters or single tumor cells.
